column4: TEST-006 runs the suite against the REAL checkout and compares git status and HEAD before and after; under framework isolation nothing else observes this suite writing to its checkout (about 68 s with the deslop row)
same proof as the doc-numbering row: the second suite that once rewrote tracked files, run against the real checkout
TEST-037 (d) runs the core suite under AAI_ROLE=subagent with no environment scrub; sweeps and CI run without AAI_ROLE so no companion run carries that environment (about 1 s)

TEST-2304 (Spec-AC-03) runs the whole content suite in a disposable clone with a planted frontmatter-less document and asserts exit 1 plus an Orphans finding; the proof is that the suite's own main_content list fails, which a selected single case or a companion declaration cannot show (about 40 s, accepted in the spec)
